# string.reverse — bytes

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

The operation transforms ASCII bytes and leaves non-ASCII bytes unchanged for case conversion. Rotate moves exactly the first byte to the end.

## What this example demonstrates

The operation transforms ASCII bytes and leaves non-ASCII bytes unchanged for case conversion. Rotate moves exactly the first byte to the end.
